description: The chart displays three pie charts representing the distribution of categories across three difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard. Each pie chart is divided into four slices, corresponding to the categories N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K-, which are color-coded as green, yellow, orange, and red, respectively. The easy chart has slices labeled with percentages: N+K+ (40.6%, green), N-K+ (45.9%, yellow), N-K- (10.1%, orange), and N+K- (3.3%, red). The medium chart also has labeled slices: N+K+ (44.6%, green), N-K+ (44.3%, yellow), N-K- (7.2%, orange), and N+K- (3.9%, red). The hard chart has labeled slices as well: N+K+ (20.1%, green), N-K+ (36.2%, yellow), N-K- (36.8%, orange), and N+K- (7.0%, red). A legend on the right side of the chart clarifies the color coding for the categories. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded, and the charts do not display any particular ordering of the slices.
